      lane is clean and carries the closed χ-ledger as a hypothesis. (§6b, §6d)

      other. Happened on the `hrank` leaf, refuted by `O_{P^1_A}/x`. The cure is a non-vacuity
      witness — exhibit an object satisfying the hypotheses and fire the theorem at it. (§6c)

      square brackets, so it is a hypothesis, so the axiom line is clean and always will be.
      `hasRationalResidues_of_isAlgClosed` had three such binders, two with no producer for a bare

      binder, so a file proves correct-looking theorems about a definition pinned to the wrong one.

      cross-file identity that ought to be `rfl` and is not. Absorbed from `I-0432`; met in the wild
      and now documented at `RiemannRoch/Adelic/ResidueField.lean:786-800` — explicit

      alone does not activate it; only `open scoped AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme` does.

      axiom-clean, instantiable, consistent, non-vacuous by every probe, and empty. Measured on the
      χ-ledger's `hbump` (probe §2b): iterating it down the anti-effective cone forces `h¹` to grow

      turns out usable *more generally* than believed, audit the widened quantifier for members
      where the project derives the negation — widening one reading can make it strictly stronger
      exactly where the project can prove the opposite.
